hints.title: Trimming Whitespace and Normalizing Case
hints.text: Trim both leading and trailing whitespace and convert the product name to lowercase.

hints.title: Extracting Year and Month Date Format
hints.text: format the sale date to year-month format using date_format or string slicing.

hints.title: Group Aggregation by Cleaned Attributes
hints.text: group by the cleaned product name and month format, counting occurrences with count(*).

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT LOWER(TRIM(product_name)) AS product_name,
       DATE_FORMAT(sale_date, '%Y-%m') AS sale_date,
       COUNT(*) AS total
FROM Sales
GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(product_name)), DATE_FORMAT(sale_date, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY product_name ASC, sale_date ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Cleans string attributes and groups sales rows by normalized product and year-month.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Grouping on raw product names fails to consolidate entries differing only by casing or trailing padding.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Deterministic normalization enables grouping across noisy text records.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: String trimming, lowercasing, and date formatting grouped with sorting.

solutions.code:
SELECT LOWER(TRIM(product_name)) AS product_name,
       DATE_FORMAT(sale_date, '%Y-%m') AS sale_date,
       COUNT(*) AS total
FROM Sales
GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(product_name)), DATE_FORMAT(sale_date, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY product_name ASC, sale_date ASC;
solutions.approach: String Cleaning and Date Formatting Group By

solutions.code:
SELECT LOWER(TRIM(product_name)) AS product_name,
       TO_CHAR(sale_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS sale_date,
       COUNT(*) AS total
FROM Sales
GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(product_name)), TO_CHAR(sale_date, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY product_name ASC, sale_date ASC;
